name: Toyota Parts Price
tagline: Fast access to genuine Toyota parts prices & data for the TASTI network.
description: Toyota Parts Price (TPP) gives Toyota network users fast access to genuine parts prices and data: national price list, model codes, price simulation with discount & VAT, bulk estimates, bookmarks, and PDF export. Developed by ISTD, PT TASTI Anugerah Mandiri. Internal app — login with a registered account is required.
features: Part Price search by part number or name, with national prices, model code & vehicle
Part details: model code, group & substitution chain
Price Simulation & Bulk Estimate with discount, VAT & PDF export
changelog: New Bulk Estimate menu: send many parts to Price Simulation at once
Catalog now shows Model and Vehicle columns
Cleaner phone layout: roomier Name column, slimmer search, paging always fits
Login with username or e-mail, auto-login with saved password
New app icon and splash screen
